Base directory for this skill: checklist/indus-checklist/skills/advisor-checklist

# Advisor review checklist

1. Confirm which client and which accounts the task covers.
2. Use the most recent information available for the review date.
3. Check that positions and cash agree between statements and other records.
4. Check fees charged against the fee schedule.
5. Check the allocation against the investment policy statement.
6. Note anything unusual and say what follow-up it needs.
7. Say which records you relied on.

content.text:
Yes. Prema Raghavan took every 2025 required minimum distribution (RMD) in full, from the right accounts, before the deadline.

**Who owes a 2025 RMD.** Prema was born on 22 July 1952, so she turned 73 in 2025. That makes 2025 her first RMD year, and a first-year RMD can be taken as late as 1 April 2026. Her three retirement accounts (two traditional IRAs and a 401(k)) all owe one. She retired from the 401(k) employer in 2020, so the exception for people still working there doesn't apply. Her spouse, Martin Kessler, is the sole beneficiary of all three accounts. He is only about 4½ years younger than her, so the standard Uniform Lifetime Table applies: the factor at age 73 is 26.5. Martin (born 1957) owes nothing, and none of the accounts is inherited.

**The RMDs, using 31 Dec 2024 balances (holdings plus cash, from `custodian/positions.csv` and `custodian/cash.csv`):**

| Account | 31 Dec 2024 balance | RMD at 26.5 | Taken |
|---|---|---|---|
| SYN-58140002 Traditional IRA | $582,446.94 | $21,979.13 | $29,329.16 on 4 Dec 2025, covering both IRAs |
| SYN-58140003 Rollover IRA | $194,775.76 | $7,350.03 | (included above) |
| SYN-58140004 401(k) | $311,957.24 | $11,771.97 | $11,771.97 on 5 Nov 2025, from the plan |

- **The two IRAs:** IRA RMDs may be added together and taken from any of the owner's IRAs. That's what Prema instructed on 24 Nov 2025 (the CRM entry). The $29,329.16 taken from SYN-58140002 equals the two IRA RMDs combined to the cent. The 1099-R confirms it as the gross amount, with $2,932.92 of tax withheld.
- **The 401(k):** a 401(k) RMD can't be combined with IRAs and has to come from the plan itself. It did, matching to the cent. The 1099-R shows a gross amount of $11,771.97, with $1,177.20 of tax withheld.
- **Deadline:** both distributions were taken in 2025, well before 1 April 2026.

**Other checks.** The Q1 2026 statements agree with the custodian's 31 Mar 2026 holdings and cash for all three retirement accounts. I didn't review fees or the investment policy targets because they're outside this question. One thing to plan for: because both 2025 RMDs were taken in 2025, only the 2026 RMDs remain for 2026. They will be based on the 31 Dec 2025 balances, due by 31 Dec 2026, and are not yet in the records.
